_comment: The concern groups this layer's diagrams sit in, by code from code-lists/concern-group.json (placement PR3, bean 63wl). A DMN sits in `<group>/decisions/`, beside the diagrams whose gateways read it, so a `decision ref="decisions/..."` stays relative to its caller. A higher layer's same-named `processes/<group>/` is a MEMBER of the group declared here (bean 1g4s, option A); `conduct` has no harness diagram, so core declares it. The `sdlc` group left for the opt-in `sdlc` sub-graph (`sdlc/processes/`, cat-harness#991 step 23.2), and the `library` group for the `library` sub-graph (`library/processes/`, 2026-11-04).
